                                      object_id,
                                      event_id,
                                      regulators_id,
                                      ann_date,
                                      effective_date,
                                      regulatory_object_name,
                                      regulatory_object_id,
                                      regulatory_object_code,
                                      regulatory_object_type,
                                      measures_disposition,
                                      measures_disposition_code,
                                      punishment_measures_code,
                                      penalty_amount,
                                      business_restrictive_measures,
                                      punishment_time_code,
                                      debar_measures_code,
                                      institution_id,
                                      irregularities,
                                      legal_basis,
                                      detailed_content,
                                      type_code,
                                      involving_comp_id,
                                      is_effective,
                                      opdate,
                                      opmode,
                                      to_char(sysdate - 1, 'yyyymmdd') as bath_dt,
                                      cast(sysdate as timestamp) as data_ins_time,
                                      'w_fundcreditrecord.json' as task_rs_id
                                from ${srcoradbname}.fundcreditrecord
